$comment: Local IPC only. Local aliases and stable identifiers must never enter cloud requests, telemetry, logs, or crash diagnostics.
title: CorrectionHistoryPage

scope.description: Whether the rule covers one window, every window of an application, or (since protocol 33) every page of a site in every browser. stable_id is an abstraction stable id for a window rule, the application's own key hash for an app rule, and the site key for a site rule, so a client cannot act on the id without reading this. remove_classification_override and update_classification_override take any of the three.
